limitations: fixtures are authored markers, not camera captures: they carry no vendor private IFD, no MakerNote, no decodable raw data and no real preview, so a refusal is not evidence that a vendor layout is unsupported and a success is not evidence of RAW support; the pinned build dispatches on header bytes, so the four compression-marker formats are read by the generic TIFF reader and only their MIME mapping distinguishes them; no B9 write suboperation is enumerated because no owned writable fixture is cleared and the reference registry marks arw/rw2/sr2/raf read-only; ExifTool 12.76 is a secondary reference, not an oracle.
scope: read-only pinned CLI probes of owned synthetic TIFF-derived RAW fixtures (ARW/CR2/NEF/ORF/PEF/SRW header or compression markers plus owned metadata carriers) and blocked vendor-private cells; no product verification, no support claim, no vendor layout conformance claim
